records.observation: Topology2 with separate linked send/receive queues and category reference. Start scans receives first-to-last matching exact tag and sender/receiver processLineIDs (not thread IDs or size), removes first match, fills start Coord(time,gthdLineID), serializes info, returns. If absent, creates arrow with start Coord, process IDs, tag AND send size then queues sends. Final symmetrically scans sends using tag and reversed header/message process IDs, fills final Coord and serializes on match; if absent creates arrow with final Coord, process IDs and tag, queues receives WITHOUT setting size. Later start matching that receive also never sets size: receive-first path serializes default msg_size0 despite incoming send size. This is a static data-flow finding in original bytes, not runtime execution. Both sides allow unmatched queues, no time-order/size validation; process ID encoding remains delegated to unread record getters. Reflection factories exact Header/Msg types, NoSuchMethodException log/null; getPartialObjects returns new linked list of shared send objects followed by receive objects, unlike State live list. Static argtypes initially null.

records.observation: Topology1, linked partial-state list, category reference and lazily initialized static reflection argument types Header/Cargo. Start creates two-vertex Obj_State with fresh Coord(time,gthdLineID), passes cargo bytes to inherited info setter if non-null, appends and returns null. Final scans oldest-first, matches only start lineID to header gthdLineID, removes first match, fills fresh final Coord, overwrites info with final cargo if present, returns state. Thus same-category nested starts on same thread pair FIFO, not LIFO; no chronological check. No match throws NoMatchingEventException; ContentIterator catches wrapped InvocationTargetException and continues scanning, not global abort. getPartialObjects exposes live list. Reflection factories use runtime class getMethod with exact args and return null after NoSuchMethodException; other reflection failures unhandled. Header values copied into new Coords; cargo-buffer ownership still depends on inherited setter/RecCargo allocation.
